http_calls.body: var item = Zotero.Items.getByLibraryAndKey(1, 'REG12345'); if (!item) { return 'ERROR: item REG12345 not found'; } var col = Zotero.Collections.getByLibraryAndKey(1, 'COLLAAAA'); if (!col) { return 'ERROR: collection COLLAAAA not found'; } item.removeFromCollection(col.id); await item.saveTx(); return 'OK: removed ' + item.getField('title').substring(0,50) + ' from ' + col.name;
